task.description: The real task text route_task was called with.

deterministic_size.description: The keyword-scoring result (_score_size) -- same input always gives the same output.

llm_estimated_size.description: optimize_intent's own self-reported size. Empty when no intent_brief was provided for this call.

resolved_size.description: The size route_task actually used -- the larger of deterministic_size and llm_estimated_size when both exist.

mismatch_flag.description: True when llm_estimated_size under-reported relative to deterministic_size.

grounding_status.description: What optimize_intent's size estimate was grounded in. 'unavailable' means retrieval could not run and the estimate was made cold. Absent on rows written before this field existed.

precedent_count.description: Past sizing decisions placed in the prompt.

domain_invariant_count.description: Domain Brief invariants placed in the prompt.

lesson_count.description: Cross-project lessons from state/global-patterns.jsonl placed in the prompt.
